body:
Founder real-time: "northstar this whole thing" (after asking about
training a multi-main league). Added a real §12 to
docs/BOT_TRAINING_NORTHSTAR.md: a status summary of the full, real, working
pipeline built this session, plus two concrete next steps with named
tradeoffs (not just listed):

1. Native in-game inference -- the standing QUEUE bot pool still runs the
   old heuristic, never a trained checkpoint. BRAWLPIT's own real
   export_policy_weights.py + mlp_policy.h precedent is the template,
   adapted to Go (SHANKPIT's bot pool is Go, BRAWLPIT's native client is C).

2. Multi-main league -- a real, legitimate architecture (closer to actual
   AlphaStar than a single-Main league). Real tradeoffs named: genuine
   diversity payoff, but 3x compute cost on a pipeline that trains roles
   sequentially and already struggled under real load; real code changes
   needed in rl_league.py's LeagueRole/PFSP sampling. Recommended
   sequencing: native inference first.

Commit: SHANKPIT@f6434a8.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-56: northstar/roadmap for bot training -- native inference + multi-main league scoped, not built
